name: Marcus Chen
psychographics: Believes in 'experience over things'; willing to splurge on weekend activities but frugal with daily disposables
current_solutions: Uses a Bosch dishwasher; buys 3M Command strips for hanging art; orders groceries via Instacart; son uses Discord for gaming chat
frustration: Forgot to cancel the Adobe Creative Cloud trial after the free month ended; was charged $59.99 on a Saturday morning; had to spend 45 minutes on chat support to get a refund
decision_style: Researches specs on Reddit and YouTube; often defers to his wife on aesthetic purchases but leads on tech
voice: Rambling and technical; uses engineering jargon like 'latency' and 'throughput' when describing products; loves explaining the 'why' behind a choice
